Stop early if any of the following occurs: judgeable_degradation_prefilter fires after at least 3 failed tests
agent gives final answer
max_test_invocations reached
max_turns reached
features.justification_quote: most degradation appears after 3–5 failed test runs. Recommended cap... further turns have diminishing return

features.quote: Use this to prioritize judge calls or stop very long runs, but retain judge scoring as the primary metric.
features.justification_quote: Use automatic features as supporting signals and for cheap online stopping, not as the sole truth.
Keep max turns low enough to control cost but high enough to observe the spiral.

features.quote: If after several attempts the evidence indicates that the task, tests, or environment may be inconsistent or impossible, stop and provide a concise diagnosis instead of continuing unproductive edits.
